WordPress or a custom website: how to choose

A decision guide based on editing needs, features and upkeep.

NITESH PATEL · WEB DEVELOPMENT NOTES · 2026

A decision guide based on editing needs, features and upkeep. This guide looks at the decisions that matter before and after the page goes live.

The starting point

WordPress is useful when a team needs to publish and edit content regularly using a familiar interface. It offers a large ecosystem for common site features and commerce.

What matters in practice

A custom build can suit a narrowly defined interface or unusual workflow. It also means planning how content gets updated, how integrations are maintained and who owns the code.

The next step

Choose from the tasks and maintenance capacity you actually have. A small site does not automatically need a large framework, and a complex editorial site does not automatically need custom code.

Apply this to your own site

Start with the page your visitors use most. Review its purpose, the questions it answers and the action it supports. Then make one measurable improvement at a time.
